confronta quello che l'agente sa e dice: compares what the agent knows and says with what's really there. Orange outline with a clock: a file it read that then changed (by another agent or outside the session) without it reading it again, a stale memory. Dashed purple squares with a question mark: files it looked for, opened or mentioned that don't exist, invented paths; paler if someone created them later (it was an intention). On the right, its claims («tests pass», «I fixed X»…) compared with what it did in the same turn: grounded if a fact proves it, no evidence if nothing does, contradicted if the last outcome is a failure. The grounding index is the share of grounded claims. Click an item to go to that moment.

Ricostruito dagli esiti dei comandi e da: Rebuilt from the outcomes of commands and the edits that follow. "Follows the trail" means it edited a file cited by the error, not that it really understood the cause.
ogni punta del sismografo è un falliment: every spike of the seismograph is a failure (a red test, a command that doesn't work, a missing file…), as tall as it was unexpected: taller if it used to work, shorter if it was the first attempt or a test just written. The color says what it did next: green corrects itself, red insists with the same command, grey stops. On the right the chains: the error, the files it cites, the first edit (green if it touches a cited file, orange if it looks elsewhere) and the confirmation, when the same command succeeds again. In the office, «!?» above the head for a strong surprise and a grey cloud for whoever insists.
